newsitem.title: USA: Alcoa sees aluminum price recovery.
newsitem.headline: Alcoa sees aluminum price recovery.

text.p: Aluminum Co of America found aluminum ingot prices stabilizing in the fourth quarter of 1996 and beginning to recover at the end of the period, spokeswoman Bonita A. Cersosimo said Wednesday.
Asked about the company's headline, on its fourth quarter earnings report, saying "ingot prices begin recovery," she said "We found them stabilizing in the fourth quarter.
"At the end of the quarter, they were beginning to recover."
She declined to make any further comments.
